title: [AINews] Building AIE CODE: The top Coding Agent Conference
author: swyx .ai
description: Mistral’s open-weight release, frontier monitoring, and the day’s AI Twitter and Reddit recaps.
summary: It’s a quiet day, so as we have done once per conference, we’ll do a behind the scenes look at AI Engineer , now serving 6M views a month for 1.8M monthly unique viewers . CODE is the last flagship AIE of the year (there are also 2 partner conferences coming up - AIEi Shanghai takes place next week, and AIEi Sydney is a side event of NeurIPS in December).
takeaways: AI Twitter Recap Mistral Large 4 ("Le Chonk") Ships as Open Weights Release : Mistral published updated open weights for its flagship model, aimed at agentic coding and cybersecurity, with customization through Mistral Forge ( announcement , weights/blog ).
Last year we had some absolute bangers building Skills and Software Factories , predicting the death of the IDE and of course the launch of Antigravity and Nano Banana Pro.

System One models : We believe S1 “smart software” is the largest change to AI Engineering that refreshingly explores the opposite direction to ever larger and more expensive and questionably productive swarms of coding agent FactoryFactoryFactories.
